name: Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd
title: Dr. Lal PathLabs Ltd - 539524 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Diagnostics volume-led growth with FY27 revenue guided early-to-mid teens and margins held at 27-28%; no capacity-cycle signal, supply additions steady (14 labs, 12-15 next year), capex Rs 100-120 crore.

capex.quote: we are planning to be in the range of Rs. 100 crore - Rs. 120 crore kind of capex for the next year

triggers.label: Patient volume growth 8.2% in Q4
triggers.quote: this quarter, volume growth has come at 8.2%

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth early to mid-teens
triggers.quote: we are entering FY27 with strong operational momentum

triggers.label: No price hike for a few quarters
triggers.quote: if it is there, it is a few quarters away. It is not something which is immediately on the cards

guidance.quote: when I am talking of a range it could be between 13%-15%
we are looking something similar margin like between 27% to 28%
we are planning to be in the range of Rs. 100 crore - Rs. 120 crore kind of capex for the next year
next year also, we are looking 12 to 15 labs, another labs

red_flags.label: Q4 EBITDA margin 26.6% vs FY 27.2%; other expenses jump
red_flags.quote: This quarter, we have seen a sharp jump in the other expenses

red_flags.label: Reclassification of courier cost out of employee benefits
red_flags.quote: This cost was in the nature of courier and transportation costs, which was grouped under employee benefit

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT down YoY on exceptional base
red_flags.quote: PAT for Q4 FY26 came in at Rs. 132 crore compared to last year Rs. 156 crore

evasions.quote: we are not now reporting separately these numbers
we are not tracking separately because this is no more separate entity
I would not ascribe any differential impact due to GLP
